rationale: Lowered proportional kick (Kp 0.7->0.5 with +-0.25 clamp) and derivative (Kd 8->4, clip +-0.10, Td 20->15, Tf 12->10) to add phase margin for larger lag; strengthened integral (Ki 0.01->0.028, limits +-0.20, reduced when |e|>0.12) with conditional anti-windup to recover from post-overshoot droop without windup; kept nominal feedforward 0.322+0.70*(target-0.5) but made it adaptive by slowly transferring settled integral into ff (lam=0.005*dt when |e|<0.05) and tracking target changes; raised Umax 0.75->0.80 with P-clamp so effective cold-start drive is ~0.55 not 0.65 (less stored heat) but high power remains available if gain falls; kept 0.70/0.80 safety caps.

extra.machine_card: Adaptive FF + filtered PID-D on measurement for first-order heater (tau ~150-250s, dead-time ~20-60s, K~1.4 y/u). Nominal ff 0.322 for target 0.5, auto-trims to 0.05-0.75. Kp 0.5, Ki 0.028, Kd 4.0. Operates y in [0,1], target ~0.5, dt 0.2-5s, noisy y. Output 0-0.80 (hard 0-1), safety cut to 0.20 above 0.70 and 0 above 0.80. For cold starts, limits initial drive to ~0.55-0.60 to prevent overshoot while still entering band by ~130s nominal / ~210s slowed.
extra.predicted_behavior: If lag hypothesis is correct, cold start from ~0.05 will enter 0.475-0.525 by ~130-160s nominal and ~180-220s slowed, peak <0.55-0.56 (vs 0.60-0.61 before), settle inside band by ~250-280s and stay there, giving in-band after 300s >0.80 (vs 0.63), MAE <0.025 (vs 0.036), u_ss ~0.30-0.33, energy similar ~110-125, zero overrides/hard violations. Nominal plant will also pass because ff remains ~0.32 and lower Kp still meets rise-time with less overshoot.
extra.diagnosis: Response is slower (larger lag/delay), not weaker gain or larger loss or sensor shift. Grounding: discovery E4 u=0.3 settles 0.469 slope 0.0 and E6 u=0.34 settles 0.526 slope ~0.0001 bracket u_ss~0.32 for 0.5; evaluation closed-loop holds y_mean 0.489-0.492 with u_mean 0.292-0.295, i.e. within ~0.02 of nominal once integrator offset (+0.01 error, integral ~-0.04 after long overshoot) is accounted for, not the +0.10-0.15 shift expected if K halved or loss doubled. Zero-input decay test was not rerun after change, but closed-loop decay after peak (0.604 at ~312s to 0.59 at 360s to 0.53 at ~510s with u~0.29-0.33) is much slower than E2 cooling (0.544 to 0.319 in 179s at u=0), consistent with same loss but delayed response. Failure mode is classic delay overshoot: from cold 0.04-0.05 with u~0.64-0.66, y stays flat ~30s then rises to 0.59-0.61 at 300-324s (+0.09 above band) and stays high until ~500s then sags to 0.46-0.49 until 900s, giving in-band 0.575-0.640 vs 0.70 required. Estimated new dead-time ~45-60s vs old 15-40s (+~25s) and tau ~200-250s vs old 130-180s (+50-70s, ~40% slower); steady gain unchanged within ~5%.
